info.title: Convixx API
info.description:
Multi-tenant AI Voice Calling Platform backend. RAG-based question answering with self-hosted LLM and OpenAI fallback.

**Documentation:** Interactive UI at `/docs`. Raw OpenAPI JSON at `/docs/json` (same origin as this API).

servers.description: Current host (recommended for Try it out)

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Liveness checks for API, Postgres, pgvector, LLM, and embeddings.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: Admin-only customer CRUD and API key issuance (`x-admin-token`).

tags.name: Knowledgebase
tags.description: Q&A upload and CRUD with embeddings (`x-api-key`).

tags.name: Settings
tags.description: Per-customer runtime tunables stored in the `customer_settings` table. Tenant-editable GET/PATCH `/settings` (`x-api-key`). Admin-only GET/PATCH `/admin/customers/{customerId}/settings` and reset (`x-admin-token`). See docs/SETTINGS_AND_FEATURES_CATALOG.md for the full field list, scope, and defaults.

tags.name: Avatars
tags.description: Per-customer reusable voice personas. Bundles TTS provider, model, speaker and pace/pitch/loudness, with an optional per-language override map. Agents reference an avatar via `avatar_id`. Tenant-scoped (`x-api-key`).

tags.name: Voice
tags.description: Sarvam speech-to-text and text-to-speech (`x-api-key`). For ElevenLabs workspace voices and avatars, see the **ElevenLabs** tag.

tags.name: ElevenLabs
tags.description: ElevenLabs workspace **voices** (speaker picker) and tenant-scoped **ElevenLabs avatars** stored in `elevenlabs_avatars`. Use avatars when `customer_settings.tts_provider` is `elevenlabs`; link an agent with `agents.elevenlabs_avatar_id`. Listing voices uses the server `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY`; all routes require `x-api-key`.

tags.name: Exotel Voicebot
tags.description: Multi-tenant Exotel Voicebot WebSocket system. Admin CRUD for per-tenant Exotel settings (**x-admin-token**); tenant outbound PSTN dial via **Exotel Calls/connect** (**x-api-key**); live session monitoring (**x-admin-token**); HTTPS bootstrap and WebSocket status.

tags.name: Vodafone Voicebot
tags.description: Vodafone (VI) Voicebot WebSocket system. Admin CRUD for per-tenant Vodafone settings (**x-admin-token**). Vodafone connects out to us (inbound-only, no outbound trigger API exists yet), so the settings response returns the `wss://` URL to configure on Vodafone's own Streaming Object.

tags.name: Admin logs
tags.description: Daily rotating API log files on disk (`convixx-YYYY-MM-DD.log`). Listing and download require `x-admin-token`. Logs are written whenever the server process runs (PM2, systemd, etc.), not only when an SSH session is open.

tags.name: Outbound Campaigns
tags.description: Manage outbound call campaigns. Set up scripts (script-to-audio), add leads, and trigger automated calls. Requires `x-api-key`.

tags.name: Company Phone Numbers
tags.description: Feature 3 — one company, many phone numbers. Admin CRUD for `company_phone_numbers` (`x-admin-token`). Inbound calls route to a number's `default_agent_id` when set; outbound calls/campaigns may pick a specific number as caller ID via `phone_number_id`.

tags.name: Cartesia
tags.description: Cartesia TTS: tenant-scoped avatars (`cartesia_avatars`, `x-api-key`), a standalone voice browser/preview, and a diagnostic simulator. Used when `customer_settings.tts_provider` is `cartesia`; link an agent with `agents.cartesia_avatar_id`.

tags.name: Google TTS
tags.description: Diagnostic Google Cloud TTS simulator. Bring-your-own Google Cloud OAuth credentials (this server has no server-side Google TTS credential) — not a tenant-configurable production TTS provider today.

tags.name: Simulator Utilities
tags.description: Cross-simulator helpers: email a saved simulator character (settings + last audio output) and check/test SMTP configuration. Requires x-api-key.

AdminToken.name: x-admin-token
AdminToken.description: Admin token for customer APIs. Set in .env as ADMIN_TOKEN.

ApiKey.name: x-api-key
ApiKey.description: Customer API key. Scopes KB, agents, ask, chat, voice to that customer.

CustomerSettings.description: Full customer_settings row. See docs/SETTINGS_AND_FEATURES_CATALOG.md for field-by-field scope and defaults.

voicebot_enabled.description: Admin-only. Master on/off switch for the voicebot on this tenant.

voicebot_multilingual.description: If true, STT returns language tags and TTS can pick a voice per language (via avatars.language_voice_map).

default_language_code.description: BCP-47 code (e.g. en-IN, hi-IN, mr-IN) used when the caller's language cannot be detected.

allowed_language_codes.description: List of BCP-47 codes offered to the caller.

stt_provider.description: Admin-only today; current code always uses Sarvam STT.

tts_model.description: Admin-only. Sarvam TTS model (e.g. bulbul:v2, bulbul:v3).

tts_default_speaker.description: Sarvam speaker id used when agent/avatar has none.

tts_default_sample_rate.description: Admin-only. Must be 8000 for Exotel voicebot.

rag_use_openai_only.description: If true, RAG uses OpenAI only (no self-hosted LLM).

rag_history_max_turns.description: Cap on chat-history turns appended to the RAG prompt. null = no cap.

rag_distance_threshold.description: Vector distance cutoff (null = use code default).

rag_streaming_enabled.description: Stream LLM tokens back to the client (roadmap).

no_kb_fallback_instruction.description: Sentence used when the KB returns no match.

vad_energy_threshold.description: Admin-only. PCM energy level below which audio counts as silence.

max_utterance_buffer_bytes.description: Admin-only. Hard ceiling on inbound audio buffer size.

max_utterance_seconds.description: Admin-only. Not enforced in current code path; buffer-byte ceiling is used instead.

stop_words.description: Keywords that end the current turn or trigger menu/operator.

filler_ack_enabled.description: When true, filler-only STT transcripts (umm, hmm, …) increment a consecutive counter and may trigger a short TTS acknowledgment instead of RAG. Disabled when env VOICEBOT_FILLER_ACK_ENABLED=false.

filler_ack_threshold.description: Consecutive filler-only utterances before playing an acknowledgment. Admin-only on tenant PATCH; tenants may toggle filler_ack_enabled only.

business_hours.description: Weekly schedule (e.g. {"mon": ["09:00-18:00"], "tue": ["09:00-18:00"]}). Empty object = always on.

holiday_calendar.description: Array of {date, label} objects, e.g. [{"date":"2026-01-26","label":"Republic Day"}].

webhook_secret.description: Admin-only. Shared HMAC secret used to sign outbound webhooks.

CustomerSettingsPatch.description: Partial update. Every field is OPTIONAL. On the tenant endpoint, admin-only fields (`voicebot_enabled`, `stt_model`, `tts_model`, `tts_default_sample_rate`, `tts_output_codec`, `llm_model_override`, `openai_model`, `vad_*`, `max_utterance_*`, `echo_cancel_level`, `barge_in_min_speech_ms`, `barge_in_energy_threshold`, `language_switch_timeout_ms`, `language_switch_max_attempts`, `max_call_duration_seconds`, `max_concurrent_calls`, `end_call_silence_timeout_sec`, `outbound_enabled`, `webhook_secret`, `webhook_retry_attempts`, `filler_ack_threshold`) return 403. On the admin endpoint, every field is accepted.

LanguageVoiceMapEntry.description: Per-language override for an avatar. Any omitted field falls back to the avatar's top-level value, then to `customer_settings`.

Avatar.description: A reusable voice persona scoped to the customer. Agents may reference one via `agents.avatar_id`.

tone.description: Free-form label (e.g. friendly, formal, energetic, calm).

tts_speaker.description: Sarvam speaker id OR ElevenLabs voice id.

is_default.description: At most one default avatar per customer.

AvatarUpdate.description: Partial update — every field is optional.

ElevenlabsVoiceSettings.description: Maps to ElevenLabs TTS JSON field `voice_settings` (snake_case). Stored on `elevenlabs_avatars.voice_settings` and optional per-locale in `language_voice_map`.

stability.description: Voice consistency vs expressiveness. Lower values allow more emotional range; higher values sound steadier (typical default ~0.5).

similarity_boost.description: How closely synthesis matches the source voice (typical default ~0.75).

style.description: Style strength; availability depends on the ElevenLabs model.

speed.description: Playback speed multiplier when the model supports it.

use_speaker_boost.description: If true, increases similarity to the original speaker (may add latency).

ElevenlabsLanguageVoiceMapEntry.description: Per-language override for an ElevenLabs avatar. Parent object keys are BCP-47 tags (e.g. `hi-IN`, `en-IN`). Omitted fields fall back to the avatar’s top-level `voice_id` / `model_id` / `voice_settings`.

voice_settings.description: Optional locale-specific tuning; merges over the avatar-level `voice_settings` for TTS calls in that language.

ElevenlabsAvatar.description: Row in `elevenlabs_avatars`. Used when the tenant uses ElevenLabs TTS; agents reference it via `agents.elevenlabs_avatar_id`. Not used for Sarvam — use `/avatars` instead.

name.description: Display name unique per customer (e.g. “Support EN/HI”).

voice_id.description: Default ElevenLabs voice id for synthesis when no `language_voice_map` entry matches the active locale.

model_id.description: Default ElevenLabs TTS model id. If null, runtime falls back to `customer_settings.tts_model` or server env default. Choose from the voice’s `high_quality_base_model_ids` or `verified_languages[].model_id` in GET `/voice/elevenlabs/voices`.

voice_settings.description: Default ElevenLabs `voice_settings` object (JSON). Merged with locale entry’s `voice_settings` when present.

language_voice_map.description: Map of BCP-47 code → `{ voice_id?, model_id?, voice_settings? }` for multilingual calls.

is_default.description: At most one default ElevenLabs avatar per customer (partial unique index).

is_active.description: Inactive avatars are ignored when resolving persona.

model_id.description: Default TTS model id; null uses tenant/env default. Prefer a value from the voice’s `high_quality_base_model_ids`, or from `verified_languages[].model_id` for your primary locale.

is_default.description: If true, clears other defaults for this customer and sets this row as default.

is_active.description: Default true. Set false to retire without deleting.

ElevenlabsAvatarUpdate.description: Partial update — all fields optional; at least one required by the API.

ElevenlabsVerifiedLanguage.description: Per-language capability for a voice. Use `model_id` when building `elevenlabs_avatars.language_voice_map` (same locale as your BCP-47 key, e.g. hi-IN → pick the row with `locale` hi-IN or language hi).

model_id.description: TTS model ElevenLabs uses for this locale.

ElevenlabsVoiceSummary.description: ElevenLabs `Voice` object (pass-through). For avatars: set `voice_id` from here; set default or per-locale `model_id` using `high_quality_base_model_ids` and especially `verified_languages` (multilingual support is often only visible in the latter).

voice_id.description: Use this value as `voice_id` on avatars / agents.

labels.description: Metadata; `language` is often the **primary** label only (e.g. en). Do not rely on it alone for Hindi/Tamil etc. — check `verified_languages`.

high_quality_base_model_ids.description: Models this voice is tuned for; good defaults for `model_id` when a single model suffices.

verified_languages.description: Locales this voice can speak; each row suggests a `model_id` for that language. Essential for `language_voice_map` (e.g. hi-IN + eleven_multilingual_v2).

fine_tuning.description: Per-model fine-tuning state from ElevenLabs (`state`, `progress`, etc.). Informational for debugging; not stored in Convixx avatars.

settings.description: Voice default settings from ElevenLabs (if returned). Optional reference for `voice_settings` on avatars.

ElevenlabsVoicesListResponse.description: Convixx wrapper around ElevenLabs list response: always includes `voices`. Optional `has_more` / `next_page_token` are passed through from ElevenLabs when present. `language` / `supports_model` filters run **after** fetch (per page); for a complete filtered list you may need to page until `has_more` is false.

filtered_by_language.description: BCP-47 tag applied after fetch: matches `labels.language`, **`verified_languages`** (`language` / `locale`), or voice `name`. Null if no filter.

filtered_by_model_id.description: When `supports_model` was set: model id used to filter (voice must list it in `high_quality_base_model_ids` or any `verified_languages[].model_id`).

has_more.description: From ElevenLabs when returned; more pages may exist.

next_page_token.description: Pass to `next_page_token` query param for the next page (ElevenLabs).

phone_number_id.description: FK to company_phone_numbers. Null falls back to customer_exotel_settings.default_outbound_caller_id || inbound_phone_number when triggering calls.
Optional. Must reference an enabled number owned by this customer (see /customers/{customerId}/phone-numbers).

CompanyPhoneNumber.description: Row in `company_phone_numbers`. One company can own many numbers; `customer_id` is unique per `phone_number`.

default_agent_id.description: Agent this number routes inbound calls to. Null falls back to the company's oldest active agent.

is_primary.description: At most one primary number per customer; used as the default outbound caller ID.

provider_override_id.description: Reserved for future carrier-migration support (§8.5 roadmap). Not currently settable via this API.

is_primary.description: If true, unsets any other primary number for this customer first.
If true, unsets any other primary number for this customer first.

CartesiaAvatar.description: Row in `cartesia_avatars`. Used when `customer_settings.tts_provider` is `cartesia`; agents reference it via `agents.cartesia_avatar_id`.

is_pvc_voice.description: Personal Voice Clone — bills at a higher credits/char rate.
Personal Voice Clone — bills at a higher credits/char rate.
Personal Voice Clone — bills at a higher credits/char rate.

CartesiaAvatarUpdate.description: All fields optional; provide at least one.

RAG-based question answering. Uses vector search + LLM.
Requires x-api-key. Optional agent_id and session_id for multi-agent and chat threads.

question_language_code.description: Optional BCP-47 tag (e.g. hi-IN). When the tenant has voicebot_multilingual enabled, non-English values are translated to English via Sarvam Translate for KB vector search only; the original question is still used for the LLM and chat history. Devanagari text without this field may still be detected for the same purpose.

post.description:
Upload an audio question: Sarvam STT → same pipeline as `POST /ask` → Sarvam TTS on the answer.

**Requires:** `x-api-key` and `SARVAM_API_KEY`.

**Multipart form fields:**
- `file` (required) — audio (WAV, MP3, AAC, FLAC, OGG)
- `session_id` (optional, uuid)
- `agent_id` (optional, uuid)
- `stt_mode` — transcribe | translate | verbatim | translit | codemix (default transcribe)
- `language_code` — optional STT language hint (e.g. hi-IN)
- `stt_model` — optional, default saaras:v3
- `target_language_code` — TTS language (default en-IN): bn-IN, en-IN, gu-IN, hi-IN, kn-IN, ml-IN, mr-IN, od-IN, pa-IN, ta-IN, te-IN
- `speaker` — optional Bulbul voice (e.g. ritu)
- `speech_sample_rate` — optional, default 24000
- `output_audio_codec` — wav or mp3 (default wav)

**Response:** JSON with the same fields as `/ask` plus `transcript`, `stt_language_code`, `stt_request_id`, and `audio` `{ format, content_type, base64, request_id }`. On TTS failure, `audio` is null and `audio_error` explains.

200.description: Answer with transcript and base64 audio

example.answer: MarriageWale is located in Kolhapur, Maharashtra.

example.error: Missing audio file. Send multipart field `file` with WAV/MP3/AAC/FLAC/OGG.

post.description:
Upload audio (multipart field `file`). Optional fields: `mode` (transcribe|translate|verbatim|translit|codemix), `language_code` (e.g. hi-IN), `model` (default saaras:v3).
Max ~30s audio. Server needs SARVAM_API_KEY.

Synthesize speech with Bulbul v3 (default). Use `speaker` (lowercase), `pace` 0.5–2.0, `speech_sample_rate`, `output_audio_codec` (wav|mp3|…), `temperature` (v3).

**Response:** Default is JSON with base64 in `audios` (the string can be very long). For **raw audio** use query `?response_format=binary` or `?download=1`, or send header `Accept: audio/wav` (or `audio/mpeg` for mp3). Use `?response_format=json` to force JSON. Optional `filename=myclip` sets the download basename.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: If this header includes an audio media type (e.g. `audio/wav`, `audio/mpeg`, `audio/*`), the response is raw bytes like `response_format=binary`. Use `?response_format=json` to force JSON.

parameters.name: response_format
parameters.description: Use `binary` to return raw audio bytes with Content-Disposition: attachment (save in Postman / browser). Omit or `json` for Sarvam JSON with base64 `audios`.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Download file basename without extension; extension matches `output_audio_codec` (e.g. wav). Default `speech`.

200.description: JSON with base64 audios, or raw audio when `response_format=binary`, `download=1`, or `Accept` includes an audio type

audio/wav.example: (raw WAV bytes — use Save Response in Postman)

get.description:
Returns the per-tenant Exotel configuration for a customer.

`exotel_api_key` and `exotel_api_token` are never returned — only `has_api_key` and `has_api_token`.

`voicebot_wss_url` and `voicebot_bootstrap_https_url` are **always generated** by the server from `PUBLIC_API_HOST` (or the request host) and the path `customerId`; you do not configure them in the request body.

Requires `x-admin-token`.

404.description: No Exotel settings configured for this customer

example.error: Exotel settings not found for this customer

put.description:
Upserts the per-tenant Exotel configuration for a customer (one row per customer).

Optional fields: Exotel credentials, numbers, `is_enabled`, `use_sandbox`. Voicebot `wss://` and bootstrap `https://` URLs are **not** accepted here — they are computed and returned in the response.

Requires `x-admin-token`.

exotel_account_sid: String must contain at least 1 character(s)

delete.description:
Removes all Exotel configuration for a customer. This will disable the Voicebot for this tenant.

Requires `x-admin-token`.

get.description:
Returns the per-tenant Vodafone (VI) configuration for a customer.

`vodafone_voicebot_wss_url` is **always generated** by the server from `PUBLIC_API_HOST` (or the request host) and the path `customerId`; paste it into Vodafone's Streaming Object "WebSocket URL" field. Credentials are never returned in plaintext, only `has_credentials`.

Requires `x-admin-token`.

404.description: No Vodafone settings configured for this customer

example.error: Vodafone settings not found for this customer

put.description:
Upserts the per-tenant Vodafone (VI) configuration for a customer (one row per customer, shared with Exotel via `company_telephony_settings.customer_id UNIQUE` - switching a customer to Vodafone here overwrites any existing Exotel row for the same customer, returned as `switched_from_provider_id` when that happens).

All fields are optional; omitted fields are left unchanged (or default to `false`/`{}` on first creation). `is_enabled` must be `true` before `/telephony/vodafone/voicebot/{customerId}` will accept a connection. `metadata` is free-form (e.g. document the custom key/value parameters configured on Vodafone's Streaming Object) and is not enforced by the WS route. `credentials` is an opaque object stored encrypted, in case Vodafone's still-undocumented auth mechanism turns out to need one; omit it if you don't need it.

`vodafone_voicebot_wss_url` is **not** accepted here - it is computed and returned in the response.

Requires `x-admin-token`.

delete.description:
Removes Vodafone configuration for a customer (only deletes if the existing row's `provider_id` is `vodafone`). This will disable the Vodafone Voicebot for this tenant.

Requires `x-admin-token`.

get.description:
Returns both **active** (in-memory, currently connected) and **recent** (from database, last 25) voicebot call sessions for a customer.

**Active sessions** include real-time info: stream_sid, call_sid, caller/called numbers, sample rate, duration, speaking state.
**Recent sessions** include DB-persisted call history with status, timestamps, and linked chat_session_id.

Requires `x-admin-token`.

post.description:
Initiates an outbound PSTN call via Exotel **Connect Two Numbers** (`POST /v1/Accounts/{sid}/Calls/connect`). Exotel rings `from` first, then connects `to`. `callerId` is your ExoPhone / virtual number; if omitted, the server uses `default_outbound_caller_id` or `inbound_phone_number` from Exotel settings.

**Voicebot:** By default the API attaches your tenant Voicebot `streamUrl` and **`StreamBegin=atLeg2connect`** when any stream URL applies, so the greeting runs after the callee answers. Override with `streamBegin` or set `voicebot_stream` to false if you attach streaming only in the Exotel dashboard.

Returns **`exotel_call_session_id`** when a row is inserted (`direction=outbound`).

REST host is configured server-side from `exotel_subdomain` (`EXOTEL_REST_API_BASE_URL` / `EXOTEL_REST_CLUSTER` fallback).

Requires `x-api-key` for the **same** customer as `{customerId}` in the path. See docs/EXOTEL_OUTBOUND_CALL_API_SPEC.md.

callerId.description: Exotel `CallerId` (ExoPhone). Optional if defaults exist in Exotel settings.

voicebot_stream.description: When true (default), if `streamUrl` is omitted, the server sets it to this tenant's Voicebot `wss://` URL. Set `false` for PSTN-only outbound (no bot stream), e.g. if your Exotel flow already attaches streaming elsewhere.

streamUrl.description: Voicebot / AgentStream WebSocket URL. If omitted and `voicebot_stream` is not false, the server fills `wss://{PUBLIC_API_HOST}/exotel/voicebot/{customerId}`.

streamBegin.description: Exotel wire format (case-sensitive `connect`). When unset but `streamUrl` is sent, defaults to **`atLeg2connect`** so media starts when the callee answers.

statusCallback.description: Webhook URL for call status updates.

phone_number_id.description: Alternative to a literal `callerId` — references a row in company_phone_numbers belonging to this customer.

raw.description: Parsed JSON body returned by Exotel.

exotel_call_session_id.description: Row ID in `exotel_call_sessions` (`direction=outbound`) when insert succeeded.

400.description: Validation failed, customer has no/disabled Exotel settings, missing credentials, or no Caller ID available

example.error: callerId is required (or set default_outbound_caller_id / inbound_phone_number on Exotel settings)

get.description:
Proxies ElevenLabs `GET /v1/voices` using the server **ELEVENLABS_API_KEY**. Tenant auth: **x-api-key**.

**Query behavior**
- `language` — optional BCP-47 (e.g. `hi-IN`). Filters **after** fetch: matches `labels.language`, **`verified_languages[].language` / `locale`** (important: many premade voices list only `en` in `labels` but Hindi in `verified_languages`), or voice name.
- `supports_model` — optional TTS model id (e.g. `eleven_multilingual_v2`). Keeps voices that list it in `high_quality_base_model_ids` or in any `verified_languages[].model_id`.
- `show_legacy`, `page_size`, `next_page_token` — forwarded to ElevenLabs.

**Response** includes full ElevenLabs voice objects. Use `verified_languages` + `high_quality_base_model_ids` when creating `elevenlabs_avatars` (`model_id` / `language_voice_map`). `has_more` / `next_page_token` are passed through when ElevenLabs returns them.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: BCP-47 tag. Filters the returned `voices` after fetch (primary language subtag + `labels.language`). Omit to return all voices (subject to ElevenLabs account).

parameters.name: show_legacy
parameters.description: Forwarded to ElevenLabs. If true, include legacy voices in the workspace list.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Forwarded to ElevenLabs for paginated listing when supported.

parameters.name: next_page_token
parameters.description: Forwarded to ElevenLabs to fetch the next page when the upstream response includes pagination tokens.

parameters.name: supports_model
parameters.description: After fetch, keep only voices that support this TTS `model_id` (see `high_quality_base_model_ids` or `verified_languages`).

post.summary: Streaming turn: STT → token-streamed RAG → chunked, concurrent Cartesia TTS via SSE (TEMPORARY/DIAGNOSTIC)
post.description: multipart/form-data with a `file` field (recorded WAV). Response is `text/event-stream` (Server-Sent Events), not a single JSON body: events are `transcript`, `retrieval_done`, `first_token`, `text_delta` (repeated), `answer_complete`, `first_audio`, `audio_chunk` (repeated, one per synthesized sentence, in order), `done`, and `error`. Sentence-level TTS chunks synthesize concurrently (capped at 2 in flight, matching this Cartesia account's concurrency limit) while later text is still streaming from the LLM, so audio for the first sentence can start playing before the full answer is generated.
